The new Norton 450 has made its debut at EICMA 2026, and this could be one of the most interesting additions to Norton's motorcycle lineup.
Currently known as the Norton 450 Urban, this new 450cc motorcycle gets a 454cc liquid-cooled, single-cylinder engine producing 47 PS and 45 Nm. It also packs premium hardware, including fully adjustable front suspension, a touchscreen display and cornering lamps on the top variant.
